plan.title: Select Existing Upcoming Event for Rescheduling

steps.note: Open an existing event that the runner selects as suitable for rescheduling.
Open the Events list as the buyer.
Verify the list rendered successfully with the Create Event control and no error.
Verify the Live tab is available.
Verify the History tab is available.
Verify the Drafts tab is available.
Verify the Recurring tab is available.
Assert the selected event displays the required Upcoming status.
Verify the event's current state offers Reschedule Event, confirming it is eligible before starting.
